sections.title: Education Policy Issues
sections.description: This course will provide you with a deep dive opportunity to advance your presentation, peer review, and research development abilities. In addition to the diverse content areas that you will experience from your colleagues’ real-time research agenda presentations throughout the semester, you will also garner different perspectives in different methodological approaches being used at a research university, including qualitative, quantitative, and mixed methods. An emphasis will be placed on your presentation and feedback to others’ presentation.

sections.title: Education Policy Issues
sections.description: This course is an introduction to the process of conducting educational research. Its purpose is to help students learn to approach problems like researchers by examining and critiquing existing research and developing coherent "researchable" questions. Students will carry out a substantial independent project where they will develop elements of a research proposal.
